reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the report for my batch is more than the drugstore bottle gives me. At $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I would try one box.
objection: Two capsules every day is a chore, and I do not know if my doctor wants me taking 200 mg. I might just pick up a bottle at the pharmacy instead.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor saying to skip it, or a bad review about the capsules upsetting the stomach.
